description: Served in the Upper Secondary CCA Executive Committee. Represented the school at major local events including the Voices of Singapore Festival (2022) and the Singapore Youth Festival (SYF) Central Judging (2021).
Led a student-initiated Values in Action (VIA) project. Organized and executed a community clean-up drive at West Coast Park, coordinating logistics and student volunteers.
A testimonial letter highlighting my leadership qualities, resilience, and contributions to the school community.
